scientific_question: Do production-scale A0/A1/A2 global CLIP counterfactual differences primarily reflect task-relevant object/world visual change, or robot appearance, occlusion, background/rendering change, and spatial pooling effects?

frozen_upstream.transitive_ledger: configs/missing_state_audit_protocol.json transitively hash-checks C0-v2, C1-v2.1 generator and production scale, D13/D14/D15, WM-v2A/B/B.1/C-EJ, matched branches, reports, results, and checkpoints.

preflight_corrections.reason: The first inventory incorrectly vertically flipped the direct MuJoCo render; its RGB did not match the stored upright observation. No mask was admitted and no branch mechanism metric was computed.

preflight_corrections.change: Remove only the incorrect vertical flip, require bitwise direct-render/observation RGB identity, and retain the same native element-segmentation semantics.

Require native segmentation object_type=5 before matching object_id to geom ID sets; type=6 site and type=5 geom ID namespaces overlap. The first calibration branch stopped before any sidecar, manifest, feature, or mechanism result was written. No threshold, feature set, split, bootstrap, gate, or decision rule changed.

Add the resolved repository root to sys.path before repository-local imports. The failed invocation stopped before protocol/data/model loading and wrote no feature, weight, metric, or freeze artifact. No scientific setting changed.

scope.bootstrap_and_split_unit: matched branch point retaining all three pairs and eight horizons

mask_inventory.renderer: native MuJoCo element segmentation from the same agentview camera; only object_type=5 geom pixels enter geom-ID semantic classes
mask_inventory.semantic_partition: robot, parsed_problem obj_of_interest relevant geoms, other non-robot geoms, background
mask_inventory.orientation_gate: direct simulator RGB must be bitwise identical to upright observation RGB without vertical flip
mask_inventory.robot_hidden_render: temporarily assign robot geoms to otherwise-unused group 5 and disable that group only in the renderer; restore geom groups and renderer flags exactly; simulator state difference must remain zero

prefix_identity_gate.executed_raw_prefix_actions: bitwise equal float32 arrays and identical SHA-256
prefix_identity_gate.agentview_rgb: bitwise equal uint8 arrays and identical SHA-256
prefix_identity_gate.planning_observation: same keys, shapes, dtypes, and bitwise-equal numeric arrays
prefix_identity_gate.future_reproduction: all 3x8 replayed RGB frames must be bitwise equal to the frozen source sidecar
prefix_identity_gate.failure_action: stop without admitting mask, feature, or mechanism metrics

replay_boundary.reason: Frozen branch sidecars contain RGB/CLIP/candidates but no semantic masks; deterministic replay is authorized only to recover masks and no-robot visibility masks.

targets.primary: D_clip = 1-cosine(z_real_i[h], z_real_j[h]) from frozen global CLIP ViT-B/32 features
targets.secondary: delta_z = z_real_i[h]-z_real_j[h] retained for recomputation, not used to select verdicts

masked_clip.background_only_semantics: retain pixels classified as other object or background; replace robot and relevant-object pixels
masked_clip.replacement_rule: round calibration-partition mean RGB over all A0/A1/A2 future pixels to one global uint8 RGB vector; freeze before evaluation
masked_clip.interpretation: paired attribution-style OOD diagnostic; absolute masked-image distance alone cannot establish natural-image causation

clip.preprocessing: the frozen D13 AutoProcessor path on upright uint8 128x128 RGB
clip.batch_shape_policy: encode exactly A0/A1/A2 together for each branch, horizon, and variant (B=3)

region_features.pair_mask: candidate-mask union with exclusive robot > relevant > other > background priority for change-energy partition
region_features.energy: sum absolute RGB difference inside the exclusive region divided by full-image sum absolute RGB difference
region_features.occlusion: visible relevant-object pixels from normal segmentation versus potential relevant-object pixels from state-preserving robot-hidden segmentation

patch.availability: verified in preflight for the pinned checkpoint
patch.export: vision_model last_hidden_state[:,1:] -> vision_model.post_layernorm -> visual_projection -> per-token L2 normalization
patch.mask_alignment: nearest-neighbor 128x128 to 224x224 followed by non-overlapping 32x32 mean pooling
patch.interpretation: patch representation change, never transformer attention attribution

probe.model: closed-form ridge regression with intercept for V0-V4
probe.feature_normalization: calibration-only mean/std; constant columns use scale 1
probe.selection: leave-one-init-state-out CV within init31-34; minimum mean fold RMSE; exact ties choose larger alpha

shuffle.rule: derange only the newly added group across matched branch points within identical task, horizon, and candidate pair; parent features and target remain fixed

bootstrap.unit: task-stratified matched branch point retaining all 24 pair/horizon rows

representative_montage.selection: nearest D_clip row to calibration p10, p50, and p90; np.argmin first-row tie break

gates.increment_rule: held-out relative RMSE improvement >=5% and task-stratified branch-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound >0
gates.shuffle_rule: held-out shuffled-group relative RMSE degradation >0 and branch-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound >0
gates.robot_dominance: V1 incremental and robot shuffle pass; robot energy >=1.5x relevant energy; robot-only retained and robot-removed drop each exceed the corresponding relevant-object diagnostic by >=0.10
gates.object_dominance: V2 incremental and relevant shuffle pass; relevant energy >=1.5x robot energy; relevant-only retained and relevant-removed drop each exceed the corresponding robot diagnostic by >=0.10
gates.occlusion: V3 incremental and visibility shuffle pass; occlusion-difference-to-D_clip Spearman CI lower >=0.10
gates.background: background energy and background-only retained median each >=0.50; background-pixel-to-D_clip Spearman CI lower >=0.10
gates.patch_better: V4 incremental and patch shuffle pass; relevant-patch-to-D_clip Spearman CI lower exceeds relevant-pixel CI upper by >=0.05
gates.global_compression: V4 incremental and patch shuffle pass; median global D_clip / median top-10 patch distance <=0.25; top-10-patch-to-D_clip Spearman CI lower >=0.10
gates.task_dependent: at least three tasks are robot-energy dominant and at least three are relevant-object-energy dominant under the same 1.5x rule
gates.global_clip_unsuitable: at least one robot/occlusion/background nuisance label, no object-dominance label, and at least one patch-better/global-compression label

forbidden: use historical init30/35 for fitting, thresholds, montage selection, or model selection
read evaluation masks, CLIP features, or visual metrics before the calibration replacement RGB, ridge models, and montage identities are committed
use success, reward, done, final task outcome, or fixed controller evaluation for any decision
train or modify any World Model, CLIP encoder, segmentation model, C0 actor, candidate generator, production scale, reranker, or controller
run C1/C2/D20-v2, controller success, seed23/47, or controller rollouts
manufacture a fake counterfactual target or interpret future simulator masks as deployment inputs
treat masked-image absolute distance as natural-image causal attribution
treat patch representation distance as transformer attention attribution
overwrite any upstream report, result, checkpoint, or sidecar
